watches.name: Quasar Silver
watches.description: The Quasar is our latest hear-turner, a striking premium timepiece featuring the legendary Swiss ETA 6498-2 Unitas , a famous workhorse in Swiss watchmaking ticking in countless luxury watches, and turned it into a custom-made skeleton , a modification requiring the dis-assembly of the movement into its individual parts, 3D scanning and digitization, CNC machining and careful re-assembly. On top of that, it comes packaged in a Grade 5 Titanium case and bracelet. Titanium is a high-tech material used in space and deep sea exploration . Grade 5 titanium (Ti-6Al-4V) is roughly 100% to 130% harder than steel on the Vickers hardness scale, which is the primary scientific metric used to measure a material's resistance to surface scratching. Its surface density and structure require over 2x the force to indent or scratch compared to standard 316L steel. Date of availability: This product will ship from August-September 2026.
